metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded during an attentional blink task in three blocks per visit (pre-tDCS, during tDCS, post-tDCS), each approximately 20 minutes long. tDCS was applied at 1 mA intensity for 20 minutes with 1-minute ramp-up and ramp-down periods, using a 7×5 mm electrode montage centered over F3 (anode or cathode) and right forehead/Fp2 (cathode or anode). Two visits were conducted approximately one week apart with counterbalanced anodal and cathodal stimulation conditions.
